headline: Product Security Engineering Intern Candidate | Application Security
summary: Computer Science graduate (B.S., UC Irvine, Networked Systems) applying for Lucid Motors' Product Security Engineering Intern (RedTeam), Summer 2027, in Newark. Builds and security-tests his own production app backend: REST APIs, access control, 36 adversarial unit tests for web vulnerabilities. Python, C/C++, JavaScript; Burp Suite, Wireshark.

communicai_bullets: Designed role-based access-control rules that block insecure direct object references (IDOR), privilege escalation, and message spoofing; validated with 36 adversarial unit tests.

Built server-authoritative Cloud Functions enforcing authentication, input validation, and per-user and global rate limiting (5 rewrites per user/day); added server-side Apple receipt verification to detect and block subscription fraud.

Implemented multi-provider authentication (Sign in with Apple with nonce + SHA-256 hashing, Google OAuth, and email/password with server-enforced verification) and Firebase App Check (App Attest) on every backend request.
Implemented privacy controls including full account and data deletion and scheduled data-retention cleanup, and kept all credentials and secrets out of version control.
